name: ssg-edge-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Workers ISR adapter for SSG (issue #546)

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../../crates/ssg-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --release && mkdir -p ../../examples/edge-cloudflare/pkg && wasm-opt -Oz -o ../../examples/edge-cloudflare/pkg/ssg_wasm_bg.wasm pkg/ssg_wasm_bg.wasm && cp pkg/ssg_wasm.js ../../examples/edge-cloudflare/pkg/ssg_wasm.js
